SELECT eu.member_id AS expertId, u.user_name AS name, eu.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath, eu.specialty AS specialty, eu.expert_introduce AS description, IFNULL(ec.careerYear, 0) AS careerYear, (eu.is_online = 1) AS isOnline FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT expert_id, SUM(IFNULL(career_year, 0)) AS careerYear FROM expert_career GROUP BY expert_id ) ec ON ec.expert_id = eu.member_id WHERE 1=1
AND ( u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.expert_introduce LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND eu.specialty = #{specialty}
AND eu.is_online = 1
ORDER BY IFNULL(ec.careerYear, 0) DESC, eu.member_id DESC
ORDER BY eu.member_id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id WHERE 1=1
AND ( u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.specialty LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eu.expert_introduce LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND eu.specialty = #{specialty}
AND eu.is_online = 1
SELECT DISTINCT specialty FROM expert_user WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL AND specialty != '' ORDER BY specialty

SELECT eu.member_id AS expertId, u.user_name AS name, eu.profile_image_path AS profileImagePath, eu.specialty AS specialty, eu.expert_introduce AS description, eu.expert_introduce AS longDescription, (eu.is_online = 1) AS isOnline FROM expert_user eu JOIN user u ON u.member_id = eu.member_id WHERE eu.member_id = #{expertId}

SELECT certification_id AS certificationId, member_id AS memberId, cert_name AS certName, issuer AS issuer, cert_no AS certNo, issued_date AS issuedDate, expired_date AS expiredDate, cert_file_path AS certFilePath, verify_status AS verifyStatus, verified_date AS verifiedDate, reject_reason AS rejectReason, created_date AS createdDate FROM certification WHERE member_id = #{expertId} ORDER BY certification_id DESC

LEFT JOIN inquiry q ON q.inquiry_id = ( SELECT iq.inquiry_id FROM inquiry iq WHERE iq.consult_id = c.consult_id AND iq.comment_type = '질문' ORDER BY iq.write_date DESC, iq.inquiry_id DESC LIMIT 1 )

WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY c.created_date DESC, c.consult_id DESC
